testInstructions: Launch the already-built PowerToys runner from the review checkout.
Enable Crop and Lock and use both Thumbnail and Reparent/Screenshot crop modes on a normal framed desktop window.
At 125% or 150% display scaling, select a region close to each client edge and verify the output matches the red selection rectangle without a shifted shadow margin or clipped content.
Repeat after moving the target between monitors with different scaling and confirm both crop modes remain aligned.
